cold-start.span: Navigation start to the first painted frame of the interactive shell

page-open.typical.span: Click or Enter on a sidebar row to painted content, one open each for 60 pages

page-editable.large.span: The same click or Enter to the painted frame where the editor holds the whole 3,000-block page and handles input itself

keystroke.typical.span: Key event to the end of the frame that paints it, idle wait excluded

keystroke.large.span: The same, at the top, middle and end of the 3,000-block page

scroll.span: Frame intervals during a synthesized scroll of each declared view, snapped to whole refresh periods, worst view

quick-search.span: Input event to painted ranked results, 10 queries typed key by key

keystroke.split.span: Keystroke latency with two panes open

page-open.split.span: Page open with two panes open

database.filter.span: Change a filter on the 50,000-row database to the painted view

database.sort.span: Change a sort on the 50,000-row database to the painted view

database.group.span: Change grouping on the 50,000-row database to the painted view

database.scroll.span: Frame intervals while scrolling each database view, snapped to whole refresh periods, worst view
